subject: Improve test output (#931)
reason: The change modifies only build.sh (build/test-runner script: ICU build output redirected to a log file with failure tails, and per-test output files so only the failed test's output is dumped) and removes std::cout debug prints from unit tests in testing/coordinator/metadata_manager_test.cc. No module source that runs inside a Valkey server is touched, so there is no runtime behaviour — no command, reply, indexing, persistence or replication path — for a scenario to reach. This is a build/CI and test-output change with no behaviour change.
